requirement_evidence.typed_settings_and_stable_identity: Preset/entry child nodes contain real Member reference, Order and Enabled Parameters; snapshots store no Cells or playback. Media-owned intrinsic collection participates in ordinary copy/persistence.
requirement_evidence.membership_and_nested_semantics: Core tests cover added members keeping their slots, deleted references skipping, groups retaining slots and reparented members staying in their current parent.
requirement_evidence.contextual_operations: Configurations menu provides capture/update/recall, inspection/name editing and delete through the same backend operations. Native capture/recall/visible-order and ordinary save/reload pass; generic Golden name widget is reused unchanged.
requirement_evidence.command_and_script_surfaces: Five command kinds have real typed fields and conditional Inspector visibility. Five named methods are registered on the manager and documented in its embedded script template. The complete command-kind test executes all operations, history and reload; named-script parity runs actual committed callbacks.
requirement_evidence.caller_parity_and_rejection: UI/exclusive headless intent, QuickJS app operation, hosted JSON method and named QuickJS methods share preset semantics and committed callbacks; history replay does not requeue requests. Foreign/missing command references, invalid page sizes/cursors and capacity overflow reject without mutations/history. Golden structural admission prevents generic duplication from bypassing the preset limit.
requirement_evidence.history_copy_reload: Exact grouped Undo/Redo, management/history, saved preset identity and reference remapping to copied Layers/Columns pass core tests. Existing Cell identities/definitions and logical playback remain unchanged.
requirement_evidence.disabled_and_active_outgoing_state: Preset rename/update work while the Matrix is disabled. Recall mutes/resumes outgoing retained content without replacing its pinned source or changing logical playback; current mix and Cell definitions remain stable.
requirement_evidence.bounded_sparse_work: A 1000-Layer by 1000-Column Matrix retains zero materialized Cells through capture/reorder/recall. Preset node growth is bounded by axis count, independent of the million empty addresses. Capture uses a detached tree; update inserts an entry forest; recall queues one prevalidated edit batch.
requirement_evidence.bounded_offscreen_inspector: Immutable member query visits at most the requested 1-128 sibling entries via a validated UUID cursor, without loading the Matrix or preset forest. UI pages32 names and selects real entries. Native next/previous paging and generic Enabled edits succeed on Layer33 while its row is absent from the virtualized grid.
